text.p: Buckeye Cellulose Corp and Merfin International Inc said in a joint statement Tuesday that Merfin's board of directors unanimously recommends that shareholders accept a new Buckeye offer of C$7.00 per share for the company.
Buckeye has been given access to Merfin's data room and facilities for the purpose of satisfying certain conditions set forth in the increased offer, the companies said.
The offer is expected to be mailed, together with Merfin's supporting director's Circular, to shareholders on or before May 5, the companies said.
Buckeye Cellulose had previously made offers to acquire Merfin for C$6.50 a share and an earlier C$6.00 a share offer.
